name: theory-skills
description: Claude Code skills for design review and code review: named principles, explained as plain-language consequences, and a gate that blocks new WCAG A failures.

plugins.name: design-theory
plugins.description: 16 clusters of design theory as the rationale and review lens for UI, copy, layout, charts, motion and brand, and equally for specs, architecture, code and infra, explained as plain-language consequences.

plugins.name: code-theory
plugins.description: Reviews code against eight areas of computer-science principle (tests, reliability, simplicity, maintainability, privacy, security, architecture, design for the context of use). Every finding needs evidence, and each is explained as a plain-language consequence.

plugins.name: design-gate
plugins.description: Stops Claude from finishing a turn while the UI it just wrote fails WCAG A (missing alt text, unlabelled fields and buttons, keyboard traps), with the fix for each. Only new lines are judged; the same check runs as a GitHub Action on pull requests.
